description: Strict access resolution. Identical query semantics to the lenient policy, but the merge rule differs: under the strict policy the primary set does NOT override the accumulated secondary grants by replacement; instead every set (secondary first, then primary) is folded into one prepared map where an explicit denial always overrides a prior grant for the same key. The result is that a key denied by any contributing set stays denied. hasAccess requires all queried keys true; hasAnyAccess requires at least one queried key true.

cases.expected_output:
mode=strict
all[foo]=true
all[qux]=true
all[bar]=false
all[fred]=false
all[foo,bar]=false
any[foo,bar]=true
any[bar,fred]=false
